notes.title: Release is coming earlier!
notes.notes:
Official game release date changed:
21 Ott 2016 @ 3:00am PDT
21 Ott 2016 @ 10:00am UTC

Why that?
Well, I fixed all the known issues and I need your feedbacks! :D
The game will come out at his 1.2.1 version, you will find all the details and release notes in-game in the News section.

notes.title: Working on it!
notes.notes:
Hello to everyone!
I just wanna say thank you to everyone who is interested in my game, al the support means a lot! ːsteamhappyː 

I'm sorry for the delay on the release, but I'm currently working on fixing some problems with Steam integration and, in the meanwhile, I've added a full in-game controller support.

Thank you for your patience.
